The common KA journey

Three timelines.

Pending is not “not KA.”

Waiting for review or contact data does not mean the caller is unqualified. A late QA decision can reopen reconciliation.

Missing form is not a dead end.

Keep a confirmed KA. Enrich when the normal route cannot finish, and retain a phone-only KA if details remain incomplete.

The delay is not a timer.

Usually next day, sometimes 1–5 days. Complete the normal route when ready; do not automatically delete records at the end of that window.

Capture uses an existing verified HubSpot contact when possible; an unmatched placeholder is conditional on the proposed capture settings. Identity must be verified before linking or any approved duplicate merge. “Enrich” intentionally leaves the provider and manual-versus-automated method unspecified. KA status and an enriched email do not by themselves grant marketing-contact status or send permission.

KA-focused path: reviewed non-KA calls follow a separate contact/housekeeping process, not the Pending loop shown here. Conceptual workflow only; integrations, automatic merges, enrichment and deletion jobs are not claimed to be live.
